correlation_analysis.analysis_summary: Analysis focused on creating high-confidence mappings between Windows Event IDs and MITRE ATT&CK techniques. Prioritized retrieved techniques and looked for direct semantic matches. Only mappings with confidence >= 0.5 were included. Several events related to credential access and reconnaissance were successfully mapped.

direct_mappings.mapping_rationale: The event description directly matches the technique name and description. Clearing logs is a common defense evasion tactic.
recommendations: Implement stricter audit log retention policies.
Monitor for attempts to clear audit logs and alert security personnel.

direct_mappings.event_description: A new process has been created: Seatbelt.exe -group=user
direct_mappings.mapping_rationale: Seatbelt.exe is a reconnaissance tool used to gather information about the host. This aligns directly with the Gather Victim Host Information technique.
recommendations: Investigate the purpose of Seatbelt.exe execution.
Monitor for other reconnaissance tools being used on the system.

direct_mappings.event_description: A handle to an object was requested: \REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\.NETFramework
direct_mappings.mapping_rationale: Accessing .NETFramework registry keys can be a sign of reconnaissance to gather system information, which aligns with the System Information Discovery technique.
recommendations: Monitor registry access to sensitive areas like .NETFramework.
Investigate the process requesting access to the registry key.

direct_mappings.event_description: An attempt was made to access an object: \REGISTRY\MACHINE\SYSTEM\ControlSet001\Control\Lsa
direct_mappings.mapping_rationale: Accessing LSA registry keys is a strong indicator of an attempt to access LSA Secrets for credential theft.
recommendations: Investigate the process attempting to access the LSA registry keys.
Implement measures to protect LSA secrets, such as Credential Guard.

direct_mappings.event_description: A handle to an object was requested: \Device\HarddiskVolume2\Windows\System32\lsass.exe
direct_mappings.mapping_rationale: Accessing lsass.exe memory is a common technique for credential dumping, directly aligning with the LSASS Memory technique.
recommendations: Investigate the process accessing lsass.exe memory.
Implement measures to protect LSASS memory, such as Credential Guard.

direct_mappings.mapping_rationale: Reading Credential Manager credentials falls under the broader category of accessing sensitive credential information, which aligns with LSA Secrets.
recommendations: Investigate the process accessing Credential Manager.
Enforce strong password policies and multi-factor authentication.

direct_mappings.mapping_rationale: Reading Vault credentials falls under the broader category of accessing sensitive credential information, which aligns with LSA Secrets.
recommendations: Investigate the process accessing Vault credentials.
Enforce strong password policies and multi-factor authentication.

direct_mappings.mapping_rationale: Reading Vault credentials falls under the broader category of accessing sensitive credential information, which aligns with LSA Secrets.
recommendations: Investigate the process accessing Vault credentials.
Enforce strong password policies and multi-factor authentication.

overall_recommendations: Prioritize investigation of credential access attempts, especially those targeting LSASS memory and LSA secrets.
Implement measures to protect LSASS memory and LSA secrets, such as Credential Guard.
Monitor for reconnaissance activity and investigate any suspicious processes.
Strengthen audit log retention policies and monitor for attempts to clear logs.
